visualCharacteristics.purpose: Boxed live data figures (value, delta, label, last update) from dati.terna.it
visualCharacteristics.description: White band: blue eyebrow, dark-blue uppercase title, paragraph; three light grey-blue (#f3f6fb) live data boxes (Fabbisogno, Generazione, Trasmissione) with big blue values and timestamps; "VAI AL PORTALE DATI >" link.

contentPattern.summary: Three boxed live data figures (value, delta arrow, label, timestamp).
contentPattern.structure: either one cell with a link to /widgets/<path>/<name>.html (loads the live widget), or a snapshot table with one row per box: title | zone | value | delta | label | last update (one cell each, or one cell with one paragraph each). Delta (a percentage), value (starts with a number) and the last-update line are recognised by content, so any can be omitted
contentPattern.sourceContent: 3 live data boxes fed from dati.terna.it (value, delta, label, last update)

usage: Homepage Dati.Terna section: Fabbisogno, Generazione, Trasmissione.
reuseGuidance: Use for boxed headline figures. For a scrolling strip of key/value figures use widget-ticker.
